description: A mine sends ore to the surface in small and large wagons. A small wagon hold 20 units of ore while a large wagon holds 50 units of ore. To avoid taking up too much space on the ramps, the number of small wagons must be at least twice as much as the number or large wagons. In addition, at least 10 large wagons must be used. If 2000 units of ore need to taken to the surface, minimize the total number of wagons needed.

SmallWagonCapacity.definition: Capacity of a small wagon in units of ore

LargeWagonCapacity.definition: Capacity of a large wagon in units of ore

MinSmallToLargeRatio.definition: Minimum ratio of small wagons to large wagons

MinLargeWagons.definition: Minimum number of large wagons required

TotalOre.definition: Total units of ore to be transported

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of wagons (small and large) used to transport 2000 units of ore to the surface"
